authentication: Public price-list file retrieval is proposed; authenticated Price List API calls are outside this dossier.
attribution: Preserve AWS service, product, term, region, currency, unit, effective date and exact file version.
retention: Retain selected immutable price-list files and proof, not an unbounded mirror of all services.
personal_data_treatment: Public commercial catalog only; reject account, customer or negotiated private pricing data.
license_notes: AWS terms, bulk-file size and selected services require explicit review before any acquisition.
emergency_disable: No download work order, AWS credential or scheduler exists; future files require exact URL and size admission.
initial_scope: Proposed selected EC2, storage and networking public list-price files for bounded regions and versions.
